environment: Local Windows host; production web build; loopback replay with 50 ms injected delay. API, generator and PostgreSQL share the host.

apiTimingDecision.decision: Keep 18 API runs as descriptive results. Native k6 HTTP timing uses a wall clock. No latency or capacity acceptance claim.

audit.reconciliationScope: All HTTP 200 reconciliation rows in rest-v2, rest-v3 and rest-v4 folders. Includes preparation, warm-up, main and stopped runs. Excludes v1 and probes outside a measured run.
